retrievalProfile.description: A somber, low-key monochromatic portrait with a centered subject and clean, high-contrast serif typography positioned across the lower third.
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif minimalist designs are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, monochromatic portrait of a male figure looking downward in a contemplative pose, wearing a dark v-neck shirt. The lighting is soft but directional, creating deep shadows. The typography is a classic serif, layered horizontally across the mid-to-lower section of the frame, utilizing white text for high legibility against the dark clothing.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directs the viewer's eye toward the typography
Dark clothing provides a high-contrast canvas for white text
Monochromatic blue-grey tint unifies the background and subject
coreInvariants: Horizontal text placement across the chest area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and fills approximately 80% of the vertical frame, cropped from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, highlighted by soft lighting, serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the illuminated face, follows the downward gaze to the text, and then moves across the horizontal typographic line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the background is a soft, out-of-focus gradient that blends with the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and shadows (background and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a wide value range from deep blacks to bright white highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and alignment contrast within the same serif family.

preserve: High contrast between text and dark background

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif proportions and high legibility
Sharp serifs and elegant stroke contrast

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, cool-toned studio portrait of a man in a dark v-neck shirt, looking down thoughtfully. Use soft, directional lighting to create depth and shadows on the face and clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text in white. Place the primary name in a large font size across the center-left of the chest. Place the secondary title in a smaller font size, right-aligned directly beneath the end of the primary name.

verificationChecks: Is the image monochromatic with a blue or grey tint?
Is the subject looking down in a contemplative manner?
Is the text white and high-contrast against the shirt?
Is the typography a classic serif in all caps?

mustRedesign: Do not use bright or warm colors
Ensure the subject is not looking directly at the camera
postGenerationChecks: Check for clear serif definition in all caps
Verify the right-aligned relationship of the subtitle
Ensure the subject's gaze leads toward the text area
Confirm the monochromatic blue-grey color grade
recipe.reuseFormula: Contemplative Portrait + Monochromatic Grade + Classical Serif Overlay
